en.description:
Solve number equations in a crossword-style grid! Challenge your brain with this hardcore math puzzle game.

Sharpen your mind and test your math skills with Math Cross: Puzzle Word, a captivating game that blends the logic of crosswords with the thrill of solving number equations.   

Forget boring drills – in Math Cross, you'll fill in a grid by finding the solutions to horizontal and vertical math problems. It's like a crossword puzzle, but with numbers and operators! Each row and column presents an equation you need to solve to correctly fill in the squares.   

Features:

Unique Gameplay: A fresh twist on classic crossword puzzles, using mathematical equations.   
Brain-Boosting Fun: Challenge your arithmetic skills, logical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.   
Increasing Difficulty: Progress through levels that offer a satisfying range of challenges to keep your brain engaged.   
Intuitive Interface: Easy to pick up and play, with a clean and user-friendly design.
Are you ready to put your brainpower to the ultimate test? Download Math Cross: Puzzle Word today and become a master of mathematical crosswords!

Music: Lullaby
by Maarten Schellekens
en.subtitle: Number iq logic 4 mental brain
